Daily Briefing — Wednesday, May 27 2026

Agentic AI governance and enterprise-scale deployment dominate technology discussion; regulatory frameworks solidify across finance and compliance.

Financial Services Technology

#1 — EC-Council Launches Adopt, Defend, Govern (ADG) AI Framework with Self-Assessment Tool for Enterprise Financial Services — SecurityBrief US

★ R+ product targets sell-side financial services; EC-Council's ADG framework—with input from Citi, JPMorgan, KPMG, Deloitte, Salesforce—provides the governance blueprint for regulated AI deployment that Eidosmedia's compliance-focused customers demand.

EC-Council launched the Adopt, Defend, Govern AI framework and a free self-assessment tool developed with input from Citi, JPMorgan Chase, Microsoft, KPMG, Deloitte and Salesforce, intended to give companies a practical model for securing and governing AI systems as adoption moves beyond pilot projects into broader operational use. The framework sets out three pillars, 12 minimum controls and nine governance surfaces, with references to existing standards including the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Agentic AI, and MITRE ATLAS.
